alshanex_familiars:birds_spell.name: Rhapsody
alshanex_familiars:birds_spell.description: Summons little birds that will cheer you and your allies, giving you a little boost for some time.

alshanex_familiars:default_note.name: Chord Blast
alshanex_familiars:default_note.description: Perform a simple melody to hurt enemies, known to be so catchy that people can't get away from it.

alshanex_familiars:end_mayhem.name: End's Mayhem
alshanex_familiars:end_mayhem.description: This spell allows you to become the ruler of the end while casting it, allowing you to use the full power of the end dimension to kill your target.

alshanex_familiars:explosion_melody.name: Grand Finale
alshanex_familiars:explosion_melody.description: Performs an outrageous melody that traps the enemies and annihilates them with an explosive climax.

alshanex_familiars:fire_fist.name: Fire Fist
alshanex_familiars:fire_fist.description: Strike with a powerful fire fist burning everything in the way.

alshanex_familiars:guardian_angel.name: Celestial Chant
alshanex_familiars:guardian_angel.description: Calls the angels to play an angelic melody that will heal and protect you and your allies.

alshanex_familiars:harp_symphony.name: Crescendo
alshanex_familiars:harp_symphony.description: Performs a rumbling melody that hurts and stuns the enemy.

alshanex_familiars:ice_age.name: Ice Age
alshanex_familiars:ice_age.description: Freeze everything around you, covering the world in ice.

alshanex_familiars:ice_chamber.name: Ice Chamber
alshanex_familiars:ice_chamber.description: Shoot a freezing ray that will freeze an area around the impact and sometimes even the enemy itself.

alshanex_familiars:lullaby.name: Serenade
alshanex_familiars:lullaby.description: Start playing a slow-paced, harmonious melody to make your enemies sleepy.

alshanex_familiars:megido.name: Electric Rain
alshanex_familiars:megido.description: Summon the wrath of the heavens, striking with lightnings every entity that dares to come around.

alshanex_familiars:music_bolt.name: Clef
alshanex_familiars:music_bolt.description: Shoots a simple note towards the enemy.

alshanex_familiars:sonata.name: Sonata
alshanex_familiars:sonata.description: Start playing a fast-paced song for everyone to hear, an harmonious melody to hurt your enemies.

alshanex_familiars:summon_shadows.name: Call the Shadows
alshanex_familiars:summon_shadows.description: Call shadow knights into your world, they are invulnerable and will pursue the enemy relentlessly.

dacxirons:acid_ball_spell.name: Acid Fireball
dacxirons:acid_ball_spell.description: Unleash a poisonous flaming ball upon your enemies

dacxirons:bloody_arrow.name: Bloody Arrow
dacxirons:bloody_arrow.description: Projectile full of dread and gore, inflicts bleeding

dacxirons:crimson_oath.name: Crimson Oath
dacxirons:crimson_oath.description: Reduce your health critically and begin to bleed, but your blood empowers your spells

dacxirons:eldritch_slash.name: §kEldritch Slash
dacxirons:eldritch_slash.description: Unleash an uninterruptible slash infused by Kamath himself

dacxirons:fairys_wish_spell.name: Fairy's Wish
dacxirons:fairys_wish_spell.description: Your wish has been granted, receive 2 randomly chosen positive effects

dacxirons:summon_pyro_knight.name: Summon Pyro Knight
dacxirons:summon_pyro_knight.description: A blazing guard comes to your defense

dacxirons:summon_weakness.name: Summon Weakness
dacxirons:summon_weakness.description: These spider-like critters come to your bloody aid

dacxirons:summonkamath.name: §kEldritch Champion
dacxirons:summonkamath.description: Summon the eldritch champion, Kamath himself

dacxirons:sunleia_beam.name: Sunleia Beam
dacxirons:sunleia_beam.description: A beam straight from the depths of the burning sun

dacxirons:suns_wrath.name: Sun's Wrath
dacxirons:suns_wrath.description: Summon an AOE embodiment of Sunleia's wrath, cursing those who enter

dacxirons:triple_fireball_spell.name: Triple Fireball
dacxirons:triple_fireball_spell.description: Unleash three consecutive balls of fire

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:chunker.name: Chunker
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:chunker.description: Summons a large rolling dirt block that moves forward, damaging and knocking back enemies in its path.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:crystalline_conduit.name: Crystalline Conduit
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:crystalline_conduit.description: Creates a large amethyst cluster that pulses with geo energy, granting Geo Spell Power to the caster while inside its radius. When it resonates with Pillar of the Resounding Earth, it restores mana to the caster.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:dripstone_bolt.name: Dripstone Bolt
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:dripstone_bolt.description: Fires a shard of dripstone that shatters on impact, damaging the target and 50% of its damage in a small area.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:eroding_boulder.name: Eroding Boulder
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:eroding_boulder.description: Shoots out a small boulder that explodes on contact, dealing damage to nearby enemies and applying the Erode effect.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:fissure.name: Fissure
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:fissure.description: Creates a fissure that travels forward, and erupts in a small spike that deals damage.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:geo_conductor.name: Geo Conductor
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:geo_conductor.description: Summons a small geo pillar that resonates with nearby allies, releasing periodic waves energy. Standing near it grants stacking bonuses to Armor and Spell Resistance to every element. Can serve as the main resonance conductor for Pillar of the Resounding Earth.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:petrivise.name: Petrivise
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:petrivise.description: Raises two massive stone walls on opposite sides that slam together, crushing enemies caught between them. The impact funnels targets toward the center, lining them up for follow-up attacks.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:pillar_of_the_resoun.name: Pillar Of The Resounding Earth
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:pillar_of_the_resoun.description: Summons a large geo pillar that sends out powerful shockwaves, damaging enemies while shredding their Armor and Spell Resistance to every element. The shockwaves resonate with nearby geo entities. Certain geo entities may trigger additional special effects when struck by a resonance shockwave.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:seismic_surf.name: Seismic Surf
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:seismic_surf.description: Summons a large rideable boulder that rises into the air and moves forward on its own in the direction you're looking. Near the end of its duration, it'll safely drop the rider down. Rider can trigger this drop early by casting Counterspell on it.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:solar_beam.name: Solar Beam
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:solar_beam.description: Unleashes a continuous beam of solar energy in a straight line, damaging all entities caught within. Can only be obtained by defeating Umvuthi, The Sunbird.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:solar_chorus.name: Solar Chorus
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:solar_chorus.description: Summons Umvuthana Raptors to fight for you. Each Umvuthana Raptor spawns with 2 Umvuthana Cranes. Can only be obtained from Umvuthana Raptor.

info: Chance to Summon: §rUmvuthana Crane, Umvuthana Raptor§r [§r3§r]
Chance to Summon: §rUmvuthana Crane, Umvuthana Raptor§r [§r6§r]
Chance to Summon: §rUmvuthana Crane, Umvuthana Raptor§r [§r9§r]

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:solar_storm.name: Solar Storm
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:solar_storm.description: Applies an effect that calls continuous sunstrikes onto nearby enemies, damaging them and setting them on fire. Can only be obtained by defeating Umvuthi, The Sunbird.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:tremor_spike.name: Tremor Spike
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:tremor_spike.description: Erupts multiple spikes in expanding rings around the caster, dealing damage and knocking up nearby entities.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:tremor_step.name: Tremor Step
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:tremor_step.description: Applies an effect that deals damage to nearby enemies while sprinting and grants increased movement speed to the caster.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:weeping_cluster.name: Weeping Cluster
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:weeping_cluster.description: Creates a unique crying obsidian cluster that stores damage dealt to entities in its radius each 1s. If the stored damage exceeds the cluster’s capacity, or when the cluster expires, it detonates and deals the stored damage in the area.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:weeping_wall.name: Weeping Wall
gtbcs_geomancy_plus:weeping_wall.description: Creates a wall of obsidian by carefully placing multiple pillars, that blocks incoming damage and acts as a shield. When the wall expires or is destroyed, it releases the stored damage in an area around it.

irons_spellbooks:abyssal_shroud.name: §kAbyssal Shroud
irons_spellbooks:abyssal_shroud.description: Cloak yourself with the shadows of the abyss, granting the ability to evade any attack for a short duration of time.

irons_spellbooks:acid_orb.name: Acid Spit
irons_spellbooks:acid_orb.description: Spit an orb of acid, splashing in a radius upon impact and rending creatures hit, melting away and reducing their armor

irons_spellbooks:acupuncture.name: Acupuncture
irons_spellbooks:acupuncture.description: Around a targeted creature, create a field of blood needles in every direction, shooting down and healing you for 25% of damage done

irons_spellbooks:angel_wing.name: Angel Wings
irons_spellbooks:angel_wing.description: Cast to gain wings made of holy energy, acting as an elytra, for a brief period of time.

irons_spellbooks:arrow_volley.name: Arrow Volley
irons_spellbooks:arrow_volley.description: Around a targeted creature or block, summon a rolling wave of magical arrows from the sky.

irons_spellbooks:ascension.name: Ascension
irons_spellbooks:ascension.description: Cast to strike lightning at your feet and ascend quickly into the air, and gain reduced gravity for a short duration. The lightning bolt deals damage and knocks back creatures struck.

irons_spellbooks:ball_lightning.name: Ball Lightning
irons_spellbooks:ball_lightning.description: Conjure an orb of lightning that slowly moves forward, damaging creatures it phases through and bouncing off blocks.

irons_spellbooks:black_hole.name: Black Hole
irons_spellbooks:black_hole.description: Around a targeted location, create a fissure into the void, manifesting a black hole that will suck in nearby creatures and slowly crush them to death

irons_spellbooks:blaze_storm.name: Blaze Storm
irons_spellbooks:blaze_storm.description: Hold to unleash a barrage of blaze fireballs, shooting rapidly but wildly in front of you and igniting any creatures or blocks hit.

irons_spellbooks:blessing_of_life.name: Blessing of Life
irons_spellbooks:blessing_of_life.description: Cast to target any creature, showing a glowing outline. Completing the cast will heal this creature.

irons_spellbooks:blight.name: Blight
irons_spellbooks:blight.description: Target a creature to blight them, reducing their incoming healing and outgoing damage

irons_spellbooks:blood_needles.name: Blood Needles
irons_spellbooks:blood_needles.description: Create a ring of needles made from blood and fire them forward, skewering targets and healing you for 25% of damage done

irons_spellbooks:blood_slash.name: Blood Slash
irons_spellbooks:blood_slash.description: Slash forward to send out a concentrated blade of blood, slicing through creatures and healing for 15% of damage done.

irons_spellbooks:blood_step.name: Blood Step
irons_spellbooks:blood_step.description: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, or directly behind any targeted creature. Gain a short duration of true invisibility upon reaching your destination.

irons_spellbooks:burning_dash.name: Burning Dash
irons_spellbooks:burning_dash.description: Quickly launch yourself forward in a haze of fire, searing creatures you pass through while in a blaze.

irons_spellbooks:chain_creeper.name: Chain Creeper
irons_spellbooks:chain_creeper.description: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a ring of creeper heads that falls to the ground and explodes. Any creature killed by this blast will conjure another, smaller, ring of creeper heads. This can chain multiple times.

irons_spellbooks:chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
irons_spellbooks:chain_lightning.description: Start a chain of lightning from a targeted creature, causing waves of zapping magic to cascade to nearby creatures

irons_spellbooks:charge.name: Charge
irons_spellbooks:charge.description: Imbue yourself with the power of lightning, increasing your speed and combat abilities.

irons_spellbooks:cleanse.name: Cleanse
irons_spellbooks:cleanse.description: Pray to a divine magic to cleanse yourself and nearby allies of harmful status effects.

irons_spellbooks:cloud_of_regeneration.name: Cloud of Regeneration
irons_spellbooks:cloud_of_regeneration.description: Hold to slowly heal friendly creatures within a radius around you.

irons_spellbooks:cone_of_cold.name: Cone of Cold
irons_spellbooks:cone_of_cold.description: Hold to cast out a cone of cold energy, freezing creatures in its path.

irons_spellbooks:counterspell.name: Counterspell
irons_spellbooks:counterspell.description: Cast to interrupt any targeted magical process, such as a casting creature or a magical projectile.

irons_spellbooks:devour.name: Devour
irons_spellbooks:devour.description: Pull in a nearby creature and attack them with a bite, leeching 15% of damage done as health. If the creature is killed, you temporarily gain additional max HP. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Yorhavich.

irons_spellbooks:divine_smite.name: Divine Smite
irons_spellbooks:divine_smite.description: With a fervor of holy energy, swing forth your weapon, doing a melee area attack. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

irons_spellbooks:dragon_breath.name: Dragon's Breath
irons_spellbooks:dragon_breath.description: Hold to spew a cone of dragon breath forwards. Each time a creature is hit, there is a chance to create a pool of dragon breath at their feet.

irons_spellbooks:earthquake.name: Earthquake
irons_spellbooks:earthquake.description: Conjure an earthquake around a targeted creature or location, causing tremors to ripple through the ground, damaging and slowing creatures in the area.

irons_spellbooks:echoing_strikes.name: Echoing Strikes
irons_spellbooks:echoing_strikes.description: While under the effects of the spell, non-magical attacks will leave an echo of ender energy behind, shortly thereafter exploding with an echo of the original attack's damage.

irons_spellbooks:eldritch_blast.name: §kEldritch Blast
irons_spellbooks:eldritch_blast.description: Fire rays of pure, devastating energy.

irons_spellbooks:electrocute.name: Electrocute
irons_spellbooks:electrocute.description: Hold to manifest a cone of electrical energy, damaging creatures in its path.

irons_spellbooks:evasion.name: Evasion
irons_spellbooks:evasion.description: Cast to imbue yourself with ender energy. Upon being attacked while under its effects, you will immediately teleport within a short radius and avoid taking any damage. Only a finite amount of hits can be dodged before the effect immediately wears off.

irons_spellbooks:fang_strike.name: Fang Strike
irons_spellbooks:fang_strike.description: Conjure a line of evoker fangs in front of you, in classic illager fashion.

irons_spellbooks:fang_ward.name: Fang Ward
irons_spellbooks:fang_ward.description: Conjure protective rings of evoker fangs around you, in classic illager fashion.

irons_spellbooks:fire_arrow.name: Fire Arrow
irons_spellbooks:fire_arrow.description: Aim an arrow made of fiery magic that will deal direct damage on impact and explode for half damage in a small radius around it. It flies straight for a duration before gravity affects it.

irons_spellbooks:fire_breath.name: Fire Breath
irons_spellbooks:fire_breath.description: Hold to spew a cone of fire outwards, igniting creatures and blocks in its path.

irons_spellbooks:fireball.name: Fireball
irons_spellbooks:fireball.description: Manifest and throw a ball of fire, exploding and dealing massive damage on impact.

irons_spellbooks:firebolt.name: Firebolt
irons_spellbooks:firebolt.description: Shoot a small projectile of fire, igniting whatever it hits.

irons_spellbooks:firecracker.name: Firecracker
irons_spellbooks:firecracker.description: Instantaneously conjure a firework where you look that explodes in a small radius around it.

irons_spellbooks:firefly_swarm.name: Firefly Swarm
irons_spellbooks:firefly_swarm.description: Emanate a swarm of violent fireflies, following a targeted creature and dealing aoe damage. If the initial target dies, the last harmed creature will be targeted.

irons_spellbooks:flaming_barrage.name: Flaming Barrage
irons_spellbooks:flaming_barrage.description: Repeatedly cast to shoot individual small fireballs, which home towards your cursor, or the creature your cursor is targeting.

irons_spellbooks:flaming_strike.name: Flaming Strike
irons_spellbooks:flaming_strike.description: Unleash a sweeping melee attack in the form of a wreath of flames. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

irons_spellbooks:fortify.name: Fortify
irons_spellbooks:fortify.description: Upon casting, fortify every friendly creature within a radius around you, giving them temporary HP.

irons_spellbooks:frost_step.name: Frost Step
irons_spellbooks:frost_step.description: Teleport to where you are looking, leaving behind a shadow of ice. This shadow will take nearby aggro, and shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.

irons_spellbooks:frostbite.name: Frostbite
irons_spellbooks:frostbite.description: Imbue yourself with a magical Frostbiting power, making any fully-frozen creature you kill turn into an Ice Shadow. Ice Shadows shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.

irons_spellbooks:frostwave.name: Frostwave
irons_spellbooks:frostwave.description: Cascade a wave of frost magic in a radius around you, afflicting creatures with chilled. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.

irons_spellbooks:gluttony.name: Gluttony
irons_spellbooks:gluttony.description: Turn your stomach into an arcane furnace, turning eaten food into mana for a duration.

irons_spellbooks:greater_heal.name: Greater Heal
irons_spellbooks:greater_heal.description: A more powerful but much slower version of heal, this spell will completely heal yourself upon being casted.

irons_spellbooks:guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
irons_spellbooks:guiding_bolt.description: Fire a slow bolt of holy energy. Creatures hit will gain the Guided effect, homing nearby projectiles in towards them

irons_spellbooks:gust.name: Gust
irons_spellbooks:gust.description: Conjure a strong gust of wind, knocking back creatures in a conical shape, causing damage if they impact a wall

irons_spellbooks:haste.name: Haste
irons_spellbooks:haste.description: In a radius around a targeted creature, or yourself if no creature is targeted, apply the Hastened effect, increasing movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, mana regeneration, and cast time reduction for a duration.

irons_spellbooks:heal.name: Heal
irons_spellbooks:heal.description: Cast to infuse yourself with holy energy and immediately regain health.

irons_spellbooks:healing_circle.name: Healing Circle
irons_spellbooks:healing_circle.description: Around a targeted creature or block, place a stationary circle of holy magic that heals allies within

irons_spellbooks:heartstop.name: Heartstop
irons_spellbooks:heartstop.description: Cast to inflict yourself with Heartstop, an effect that makes you temporarily invulnerable. However, once it wears off, you take 50% of all damage accumulated while under its effects.

irons_spellbooks:heat_surge.name: Heat Surge
irons_spellbooks:heat_surge.description: Emanate a surge of fiery magic, igniting and rending creatures in a radius around you. Rended creatures have reduced armor.

irons_spellbooks:ice_block.name: Ice Block
irons_spellbooks:ice_block.description: Conjure a giant chunk of ice above a targeted creature or block. After a short delay, it will fall down and explode for area frost damage, doing additional damage to any creatures hit on the way down.

irons_spellbooks:ice_spikes.name: Ice Spikes
irons_spellbooks:ice_spikes.description: Unleash a cascading line of ice magic, creating ice crystals that emerge from the ground. The final spike does full damage, and will emerge early if a creature within range is targeted.

irons_spellbooks:ice_tomb.name: Ice Tomb
irons_spellbooks:ice_tomb.description: Encase yourself in a protective tomb of ice, providing healing while within, absorbing one hit or counterspell before breaking. Dismount to leave the tomb.

irons_spellbooks:icicle.name: Icicle
irons_spellbooks:icicle.description: Fire a piercing bolt of cold energy in the form of an icicle, freezing those it touches.

irons_spellbooks:invisibility.name: Invisibility
irons_spellbooks:invisibility.description: Cast to briefly grant yourself true invisibility, which hides armor and held items, but immediately wears off upon dealing damage. Mobs also lose aggro.

irons_spellbooks:lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
irons_spellbooks:lightning_bolt.description: Down from the heavens, summon a bolt of lightning.

irons_spellbooks:lightning_lance.name: Lightning Lance
irons_spellbooks:lightning_lance.description: Hold to charge a spear made of lightning. Release to throw it like a javelin, dealing high damage to the creature it hits.

irons_spellbooks:lob_creeper.name: Lob Creeper
irons_spellbooks:lob_creeper.description: Lob the head of a creeper forward that explodes in a medium radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.

irons_spellbooks:magic_arrow.name: Magic Arrow
irons_spellbooks:magic_arrow.description: Hold to charge a piercing arrow made of arcane energy. This arrow has no gravity and can travel through blocks.

irons_spellbooks:magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
irons_spellbooks:magic_missile.description: Shoot a bolt of concentrated arcane magic. Also a trademark of every wizard.

irons_spellbooks:magma_bomb.name: Magma Bomb
irons_spellbooks:magma_bomb.description: Launch a bomb made from magma, exploding on impact and leaving a field of fire where it lands

irons_spellbooks:oakskin.name: Oakskin
irons_spellbooks:oakskin.description: The great power of oak infuses itself into your skin, granting damage reduction of any incoming damage for a duration.

irons_spellbooks:planar_sight.name: §kPlanar Sight
irons_spellbooks:planar_sight.description: Shift your vision in between planes, gaining the ability to see creatures through solid material.

irons_spellbooks:pocket_dimension.name: §kPocket Dimension
irons_spellbooks:pocket_dimension.description: Cast to transport yourself into a personal pocket dimension only you can access, giving a small free range area.

irons_spellbooks:poison_arrow.name: Poison Arrow
irons_spellbooks:poison_arrow.description: Charge a powerful arrow, imbued with poison magic, that will release a poisonous cloud upon impact

irons_spellbooks:poison_breath.name: Poison Spray
irons_spellbooks:poison_breath.description: Spew forth a cone of poison, damaging and poisoning creatures in its reach

irons_spellbooks:poison_splash.name: Poison Splash
irons_spellbooks:poison_splash.description: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a wave of poisonous magic that splashes down, damaging creatures hit and leaving behind a poisonous cloud

irons_spellbooks:portal.name: Portal
irons_spellbooks:portal.description: Creates two portals that allows players to travel back and forth between them.

irons_spellbooks:raise_dead.name: Raise Dead
irons_spellbooks:raise_dead.description: Cast to summon undead minions from the earth beneath you. The higher the power, the better equipment they will have.

irons_spellbooks:raise_hell.name: Raise Hell
irons_spellbooks:raise_hell.description: Slam down your weapon to wreath a fiery shockwave in a large radius around you. Damage scales based on the held weapon.

irons_spellbooks:ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
irons_spellbooks:ray_of_frost.description: Fire a beam of cold energy, dealing low damage but immediately applying freeze to the creature hit.

irons_spellbooks:ray_of_siphoning.name: Ray of Siphoning
irons_spellbooks:ray_of_siphoning.description: Hold to cast a ray of necrotic energy that siphons health from creatures it hits, damaging them and healing you for 100% of damage done.

irons_spellbooks:recall.name: Recall
irons_spellbooks:recall.description: Warps you back to your spawn location, or world spawn if there is none.

irons_spellbooks:root.name: Root
irons_spellbooks:root.description: Around a targeted creature, sprout magical roots than entangle them and completely prevent non-magical movement

irons_spellbooks:sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
irons_spellbooks:sacrifice.description: Target one of your magic summons to cause them to explode, killing them instantly, and dealing large damage in the area around them. The summon's remaining health boosts the damage dealt and radius of explosion.

irons_spellbooks:scorch.name: Scorch
irons_spellbooks:scorch.description: In a targeted area, erupt a scorch of fiery magic, damaging creatures in the zone and leaving a field of fire.

irons_spellbooks:sculk_tentacles.name: §kSculk Tentacles
irons_spellbooks:sculk_tentacles.description: From where you look, erupt a mass of sculk energy in the form of wailing tentacles, damaging and blinding creatures caught in the chaos.

irons_spellbooks:shadow_slash.name: Shadow Slash
irons_spellbooks:shadow_slash.description: Dash forward with a arcing slash of arcane energy, striking creatures in an area. Projectiles hit are deflected. Scales off held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

irons_spellbooks:shield.name: Shield
irons_spellbooks:shield.description: Conjure a stationary shield of arcane energy where you look that will block projectiles and prevent creatures from passing.

irons_spellbooks:shockwave.name: Shockwave
irons_spellbooks:shockwave.description: Coalesce a surge of electrical power, and unleash it in a devastating shockwave, blasting exposed creatures.

irons_spellbooks:slow.name: Slow
irons_spellbooks:slow.description: In a radius around a targeted creature, apply the Slowed effect to enemies, decreasing movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, mana regeneration, and cast time for a duration.

irons_spellbooks:snowball.name: Snowball
irons_spellbooks:snowball.description: Conjure a giant snowball and throw it forward, bursting into a frosty field and Chilling creatures in a surrounding radius on impact. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.

irons_spellbooks:sonic_boom.name: §kSonic Boom
irons_spellbooks:sonic_boom.description: Blast forth a sonic boom of immense power, passing through solid material and harming all creatures in its path.

irons_spellbooks:spectral_hammer.name: Spectral Hammer
irons_spellbooks:spectral_hammer.description: Conjure a spectral hammer out from where you look that will mine all connected stone-type blocks in a cube where it hits, leaving only ores and rubble behind.

irons_spellbooks:spider_aspect.name: Aspect of the Spider
irons_spellbooks:spider_aspect.description: Instill yourself with poisonous magic, dealing additional melee, ranged, or spell damage creatures that are poisoned

irons_spellbooks:starfall.name: Starfall
irons_spellbooks:starfall.description: Target a single area and continuously rain down arcane comets from above for the duration of the spell

irons_spellbooks:stomp.name: Stomp
irons_spellbooks:stomp.description: With a magic force, stomp the ground in front of you and send a short tremor forward through the ground, damaging creatures in its path.

irons_spellbooks:summon_ender_chest.name: Summon Ender Chest
irons_spellbooks:summon_ender_chest.description: Apparate your Ender Chest inventory upon casting.

irons_spellbooks:summon_horse.name: Summon Horse
irons_spellbooks:summon_horse.description: Conjure a spectral steed that will follow you around and only let you ride. The horse's speed, health, and jump height scales with spell power.

irons_spellbooks:summon_polar_bear.name: Summon Polar Bear
irons_spellbooks:summon_polar_bear.description: Cast to summon a polar bear who will follow, protect, and fight for you, as well as providing a mount.

irons_spellbooks:summon_swords.name: Summon Swords
irons_spellbooks:summon_swords.description: Conjure a trio of spectral armaments to aid in battle: a brawling shortsword, a quick rapier, and a tanking claymore. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Hazentouvel.

irons_spellbooks:summon_vex.name: Summon Vex
irons_spellbooks:summon_vex.description: Cast to conjure vexes that will follow, protect, and fight for you.

irons_spellbooks:sunbeam.name: Sunbeam
irons_spellbooks:sunbeam.description: Funnel the power of the heavens into a beam of holy energy from above, smiting targets in an area.

irons_spellbooks:telekinesis.name: §kTelekinesis
irons_spellbooks:telekinesis.description: Reach out with a spectral force and grip a creature, forcing them towards your gaze. Creatures are susceptible to kinetic damage.

irons_spellbooks:teleport.name: Teleport
irons_spellbooks:teleport.description: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, leaving nothing but a cloud of ender energy behind.

irons_spellbooks:throw.name: Throw
irons_spellbooks:throw.description: Cast to throw your held item, dealing a base damage plus damage normally inflicted by the item.

irons_spellbooks:thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
irons_spellbooks:thunderstorm.description: Cast to conjure a thunderstorm centered around yourself, which strikes nearby creatures within sight with a small bolt of lightning every 2 seconds for the spell's duration.

irons_spellbooks:touch_dig.name: Touch Dig
irons_spellbooks:touch_dig.description: Use magic to break a block. Held items affect drops.

irons_spellbooks:volt_strike.name: Volt Strike
irons_spellbooks:volt_strike.description: Leap forward in a spinning voltaic attack, striking the first creature or surface you hit, and dealing a residual blast in a small area around around the impact.

irons_spellbooks:wall_of_fire.name: Wall of Fire
irons_spellbooks:wall_of_fire.description: Recast to place anchor points, which erupts into a wall of fire when the cast finishes, or when the maximum length is reached. This wall blocks projectiles and ignites creatures that pass through it.

irons_spellbooks:wisp.name: Wisp
irons_spellbooks:wisp.description: Conjure a projectile of holy energy that will float towards nearby targets and deal damage upon impact.

irons_spellbooks:wither_skull.name: Wither Skull
irons_spellbooks:wither_skull.description: Launch a wither skull forward that explodes in a small radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.

kubejs:cannibalism.name: §kCannibalism
kubejs:cannibalism.description: Rend your very own flesh from your very own body.

traveloptics:abyssal_blast.name: Abyssal Blast
traveloptics:abyssal_blast.description: Cast to fire a devastating beam of abyssal energy in a straight line. While active, caster cannot move or look around. Can only be found by defeating The Leviathan.

traveloptics:aerial_collapse.name: Aerial Collapse
traveloptics:aerial_collapse.description: Inflict an effect that lifts enemies into the air for 2.5 seconds before crushing them down to the floor, dealing percentage-based damage to their health. The damage dealt ignores any kind of damage cap.

traveloptics:annihilation.name: Annihilation
traveloptics:annihilation.description: Targets enemies and nukes them with a devastating spell that deals massive damage. Survivors are inflicted with a radiation effect, preventing incoming healing. Can only be  found from Toxic Caves ruins and by slaying Nucleepers.

traveloptics:apex_harvest.name: Apex Harvest
traveloptics:apex_harvest.description: Cast to consume up to 5 nearby Soul Apex and recharges the Cursed Wraithblade, instantly switching it into its Apex-Shot mode. Requires Cursed Wraithblade to cast this spell.

traveloptics:aqua_missiles.name: Aqua Missiles
traveloptics:aqua_missiles.description: Fires a rapid succession of water bolts that deal damage and home in on nearby entities.

traveloptics:ashen_breath.name: Ashen Breath
traveloptics:ashen_breath.description: Exhale a cloud of darkening ash, damaging and blinding creatures in its reach.

traveloptics:astral_sense.name: Astral Sense
traveloptics:astral_sense.description: Reveals the pathfinder of nearby entities in a radius. Normal casting alerts the caster about nearby threats, while crouch casting helps sense loot, traps, and valuables like Arcane Debris.

traveloptics:axe_of_the_doomed.name: Axe Of The Doomed
traveloptics:axe_of_the_doomed.description: Summon a Aptrgangr to fight by your side and unleash devastating melee attacks upon your enemies. Can only be obtained by defeating Aptrgangr.

traveloptics:blackout.name: Blackout
traveloptics:blackout.description: Creates a lingering anti-magic field that suppresses abilities within its radius. Players caught in the zone are unable to cast spells and use items. Moving within the field inflicts small damage. Can only be obtained by defeating the Enraged Dead King.

traveloptics:blink.name: Blink
traveloptics:blink.description: Low-cost, short-ranged teleport in the direction you're moving. Works omni-directionally.

traveloptics:blood_howl.name: Blood Howl
traveloptics:blood_howl.description: Cast to shoot wither howitzer projectiles at your target. This spell has recasts.

traveloptics:bubble_spray.name: Bubble Spray
traveloptics:bubble_spray.description: Sprays a stream of bubbles that deals damage, slows affected entities, and applies the Wet effect.

traveloptics:burning_judgment.name: Burning Judgment
traveloptics:burning_judgment.description: Creates Ignis flame strikes on the ground in a straight line for a duration. If the caster's health falls below 50%, the strikes transform into soul-fired flame strikes. Can only be obtained by defeating Ignis.

traveloptics:call_forth_the_dead_king.name: Call Forth The Dead King
traveloptics:call_forth_the_dead_king.description: Summons an Enraged Dead King boss to challenge you. Defeating it grants a higher chance of obtaining high-quality loot, including the exclusive spell Blackout. The Enraged Dead King can cast additional powerful spells. The high mana cost is intentional to make it only cast-able from scrolls. Can only be found in Catacombs Chests.

info: Cast this spell directly from its scroll

traveloptics:conjure_void_tomes.name: Conjure Void Tomes
traveloptics:conjure_void_tomes.description: Summon magical Void Tomes to fight by your side and unleash spell attacks upon your enemies. Can be found in Void Cathedral.

traveloptics:coral_barrage.name: Coral Barrage
traveloptics:coral_barrage.description: Cast to mark targets, unleashing a barrage of coral bolts at the end of recasting. Bolts damage, pierce, and shatter into shrapnel, dealing AoE damage within a 2-block radius.

traveloptics:cursed_minefield.name: Cursed Minefield
traveloptics:cursed_minefield.description: On cast, summons Leviathan’s abyssal mines in a radius around the player. The mine placement is random, but they cannot go below the caster’s Y level.

traveloptics:cursed_revenants.name: Cursed Revenants
traveloptics:cursed_revenants.description: Cast to summon random Draugr variants that'll protect you and fight for you.

info: Chance to Summon: §rDraugr, Royal Draugr, Elite Draugr§r [§r1§r]
Chance to Summon: §rDraugr, Royal Draugr, Elite Draugr§r [§r2§r]

Chance to Summon: §rDraugr, Royal Draugr, Elite Draugr§r [§r5§r]

traveloptics:death_laser.name: Death Laser
traveloptics:death_laser.description: Cast to shoot The Harbinger Laser beam in a straight line. While active, caster cannot move or look around.

traveloptics:despair.name: Despair
traveloptics:despair.description: Launches a magical Axe Blade forward on the look direction piercing through entities in its path. Deals damage to all caught in its trajectory.

traveloptics:echo_of_the_abyss.name: Echo Of The Abyss
traveloptics:echo_of_the_abyss.description: Summons a Hullbreaker to fight and protect the caster. Can be used as an underwater mount, granting water breathing while ridden. Can only be obtained from defeating Hullbreaker.

traveloptics:eek.name: Eek
traveloptics:eek.description: Eek yourself and eek targeted entity.

traveloptics:em_pulse.name: EM-Pulse
traveloptics:em_pulse.description: Cast to stun nearby entities for a short duration. Stunned enemies has a visual indicator.

traveloptics:eternal_sentinel.name: Eternal Sentinel
traveloptics:eternal_sentinel.description: Conjure a friendly Ender Golem to protect and fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Ender Golem.

traveloptics:extinction.name: Extinction
traveloptics:extinction.description: Calls down a massive asteroid, smashing into the ground with incredible force. The impact devastates a large area, leaving a crater that erupts with searing heat, turning all within to ash. Only cast-able from Gauntlet Of Extinction.

traveloptics:flames_reborn.name: Flames Reborn
traveloptics:flames_reborn.description: Ignite a wave of fire, marking your place in time. If you fall, the flames will resurrect you at your marked spot, restoring you to the health you had when it was cast.

traveloptics:flood_slash.name: Flood Slash
traveloptics:flood_slash.description: Unleashes a aqua-infused slash projectile that deals damage and converts damage dealt into Mana for the caster. Hitting multiple entities increases the caster's Mana regeneration temporarily.

traveloptics:floodgate.name: Floodgate
traveloptics:floodgate.description: Imposes a damage cap on the caster, ensuring that any incoming damage exceeding the threshold is reduced to the cap. When damage surpasses the threshold, waves surge outward in all directions, dealing damage.

traveloptics:galena_shatter.name: Galena Shatter
traveloptics:galena_shatter.description: Slams the ground with Galena energy, releasing a magnetic shockwave that damages enemies and converts any Scarlet or Azure Charges into corresponding Marks. Marked targets take continuous damage over 1.5s, ignoring i-frames. When the effect ends, a final magnetic burst triggers, pulling opposite-marked entities and pushing away those with the same mark. Requires Galenic Polarizer to cast this spell.

info: Evo 3: Crouch cast to gain additional boosts

traveloptics:gyro_slash.name: Gyro Slash
traveloptics:gyro_slash.description: Transform the Infernal Devastator into Blade Mode, slashing entities in front of you. Using an Infernal Devastator Evo 2 or higher creates a slash projectile that pulls in nearby entities with a fiery vacuum effect before bursting into flame jets. Only cast-able from Infernal Devastator.

info: Requires Infernal Devastator Evo 2 or above to trigger Flame Jet damage

traveloptics:halberd_horizon.name: Halberd Horizon
traveloptics:halberd_horizon.description: Summons Phantom Halberds in the battlefield around the caster, damaging entities caught in it. Can only be obtained by defeating Maledictus.

traveloptics:herald_of_acropolis.name: Herald Of Acropolis
traveloptics:herald_of_acropolis.description: Conjures a loyal Clawdian to fight and protect you. Can only be obtained by defeating a Clawdian.

traveloptics:hydroshot.name: Hydroshot
traveloptics:hydroshot.description: Fires a small water bolt that deals damage, slows enemies, and applies the wet effect.

traveloptics:ignited_onslaught.name: Ignited Onslaught
traveloptics:ignited_onslaught.description: Cast to summon a Ignited Revenant & Berserker to protect you and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Ignited Revenant and Ignited Berserker.

traveloptics:jet_steam.name: Jet Steam
traveloptics:jet_steam.description: Generates a powerful surge that propels the caster at high speed while using elytra or swimming underwater, granting temporary water breathing.

traveloptics:lava_bomb.name: Lava Bomb
traveloptics:lava_bomb.description: Launches projectiles at a 45° angle in front of the caster, that explodes upon impact, creating lava pools. When cast, the spell absorbs nearby lava.

traveloptics:lingering_strain.name: Lingering Strain
traveloptics:lingering_strain.description: Grants a effect; During that any burst damage you get will be split into 4 different smaller damage and will be dealt over time giving the caster time to recover.

traveloptics:magnetron_deployment.name: Magnetron Deployment
traveloptics:magnetron_deployment.description: Cast to deploy a Magnetron that will follow, protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Magnetron.

traveloptics:mechanized_predator.name: Mechanized Predators
traveloptics:mechanized_predator.description: Cast to deploy Watchers and The Prowler that will follow, protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating The Watcher and The Prowler.

traveloptics:meteor_storm.name: Meteor Storm
traveloptics:meteor_storm.description: Summons Ignis fireballs to rain down from the sky. If the caster's health falls below 50%, the fireballs transform into soul-fired projectiles.

traveloptics:nocturnal_swarm.name: Nocturnal Swarm
traveloptics:nocturnal_swarm.description: Cast to summon deadly swarm of Vesper.

traveloptics:nullflare.name: Nullflare
traveloptics:nullflare.description: Cast to inflict Nullflare Ice on enemies, or Crouch Cast to inflict Nullflare Fire; when Ice meets Fire, or vice versa, it triggers a Nullflare Blast, dealing damage. Additional effect stacks increase the Blast damage.

traveloptics:orbital_void.name: Orbital Void
traveloptics:orbital_void.description: Shoots Abyssal Orbs in a circular pattern around the caster. These orbs home in on the nearest enemy, relentlessly tracking and damaging them. Crouch cast to spread orbs across multiple random targets.

info: Crouch cast to target multiple entities

traveloptics:overflow.name: Overflow
traveloptics:overflow.description: Causes water to erupt from the ground that spreads into a wide pool. The pool continuously applies Aqua Spell Power scaling Wet effect to anything inside it. The Wet effect grows stronger over the spell’s duration, reaching its maximum intensity as the spell ends.

traveloptics:primal_pack.name: Primal Pack
traveloptics:primal_pack.description: Summon Vallumraptors and Tremorsaurus to fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Vallumraptors and Tremorsaurus.

traveloptics:primordial_steed.name: Primordial Steed
traveloptics:primordial_steed.description: Summon a Atlatitan that will follow you around, let you ride. Also protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Luxtructosaurus.

traveloptics:psychic_bolt.name: §kPsychic Bolt
traveloptics:psychic_bolt.description: Select multiple targets on cast. On recast end, fires small projectiles that confuse targets on hit, making them prioritize attacking nearby non-player entities.

traveloptics:rainfall.name: Rainfall
traveloptics:rainfall.description: Calls down a rainstorm that grants immunity to negative effects for the caster and applies the Wet effect to everyone within.

traveloptics:rapid_laser.name: Rapid Laser
traveloptics:rapid_laser.description: Continuously shoots Harbinger's pew-pew laser to targeted entities.

traveloptics:reversal.name: §kReversal
traveloptics:reversal.description: Reverses any incoming damage with increased power. Additionally, it can copy incoming projectiles.

traveloptics:serpentide.name: Serpentide
traveloptics:serpentide.description: Summons a cascade of Storm Serpents that strike down in a straight line one after another, dealing damage and applying Wet effect. Damage ignores i-frames. Can only be obtained by defeating Scylla.

traveloptics:shadowed_miasma.name: §kShadowed Miasma
traveloptics:shadowed_miasma.description: Inflicts nearby enemies with the abyssal curse effect and infuses your weapon with the same curse. Dealing damage to an enemy during the effect has a chance to spread the effect to nearby enemies.

traveloptics:shear_of_the_stars.name: Shear Of The Stars
traveloptics:shear_of_the_stars.description: Summons a Dragon Spirit that flies forward, passing through blocks and damaging enemies it hits. It leaves behind a Stellar Trail that deals damage over time to nearby enemies. Dragon damage ignores I-Frames. Requires Stellothorn to cast this spell.

traveloptics:skypiercer.name: Skypiercer
traveloptics:skypiercer.description: Calls down a phantom Trident Of Eternal Maelstrom from the sky, dealing impact damage in an area. The trident remains, pulsing for 50% of the impact damage at intervals and inflicting Tidal Torment, causing thrown Trident Of Eternal Maelstrom to explode in an area and slowing affected enemies. Requires Trident Of The Eternal Maelstrom to cast this spell.

traveloptics:spectral_blink.name: §kSpectral Blink
traveloptics:spectral_blink.description: After activation, the caster has 3 seconds. During this time, they can teleport to any entity they are looking at, even through walls. Any entities within the teleportation range will be revealed to the caster.

traveloptics:stele_cascade.name: Stele Cascade
traveloptics:stele_cascade.description: Summons Ancient Desert Stele in a radius, crashing down and dealing damage.

traveloptics:sticky_steed_summon.name: Sticky Steed Summon
traveloptics:sticky_steed_summon.description: Conjure a Gum Worm that will follow you around, let you ride. Also protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Gum Worm.

traveloptics:summon_desert_dwellers.name: Desert Dwellers
traveloptics:summon_desert_dwellers.description: Summon Koboletons and Wadjet to fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Koboletons and Wadjet.

traveloptics:supernova.name: Supernova
traveloptics:supernova.description: Summon a collapsing star that builds in intensity over time. After a short delay, it erupts in a massive explosion, dealing heavy damage and gives birth to a supermassive black hole. The black hole pulls in nearby entities and continues to deal damage within its radius. Requires Wand of Final Light to cast this spell.

traveloptics:sword_of_the_ancients.name: Sword Of The Ancients'
traveloptics:sword_of_the_ancients.description: Summon kobolediator to fight by your side and unleash devastating melee attacks upon your enemies. Can only be obtained by defeating Kobolediator.

traveloptics:the_forgotten_beast.name: The Forgotten Beast
traveloptics:the_forgotten_beast.description: Summon Forsaken, a powerful, rideable creature that fight alongside you. However, beware: its will is not fully tameable, and its ferocity may prove unpredictable. Can only be obtained by defeating Forsaken.

traveloptics:the_howling_tempest.name: The Howling Tempest
traveloptics:the_howling_tempest.description: After a 3s charge, conjures a raging tempest that rains down water spears, dealing damage and applying Wet effect. Each hit has a 50% chance to either increase the Wet amplifier (up to 10x) or extend its duration by 2s. Can only be obtained by defeating Scylla.

traveloptics:tidal_grasp.name: Tidal Grasp
traveloptics:tidal_grasp.description: Pulls a targeted entity toward the caster, striking them with force to deal damage while applying a Stun and the Wet effect.

traveloptics:tsunami.name: Tsunami
traveloptics:tsunami.description: Call forth an unstoppable tide that surges forward, slamming into enemies, dealing damage, sweeping them away, and applying wet effect.

traveloptics:vigor_siphon.name: Vigor Siphon
traveloptics:vigor_siphon.description: Cast to connect with your nearest summon. Damage dealt by the summon heals you, and your damage heals the summon in return. If you die while tethered, the linked summon is sacrificed to restore you with 8hp

info: If owner dies, sacrifice the tethered summon to keep owner alive and heal them
If owner dies, sacrifice the tethered summon to keep owner alive and heal them

traveloptics:violent_skreech.name: §kParalyzing Skreech
traveloptics:violent_skreech.description: Continuously pulsate sound blast to Shred Armor, Damage Nearby enemies and Applying Chilled effect. 2% of damage deal converted into lifesteal.

traveloptics:void_eruption.name: Void Eruption
traveloptics:void_eruption.description: Shoots Void Howitzer Projectiles that explode and summon void runes in a radius. This spell can be recast.

traveloptics:vortex_of_the_deep.name: Vortex Of The Deep
traveloptics:vortex_of_the_deep.description: Conjures a massive water vortex that pulls entities toward its center, slowing them and applying Wet effect. The vortex periodically discharges Boltstrikes to devastate those within it's radius.

traveloptics:vortex_punch.name: Vortex Uppercut
traveloptics:vortex_punch.description: Create a Void Vortex, pulling enemies in. Teleport into it and unleash a crushing uppercut, dealing damage and sending foes flying upward.
